data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Thank you for reaching out, Alex. We understand your concern regarding the data retention policy. The retention policies for deleted files apply to items in a 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files still visible in the 'Trash Bin' are recoverable by users and are not automatically purged by the general retention policy unless a specific policy is set to purge the Trash Bin after a certain number of days. Please review your settings under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention to ensure the policy for the Trash Bin is configured as intended. If you need further assistance, please let us know. [T-1931] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
